# netmaker_node (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Netmaker node by network and ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Node ID to look up.
- `network` (String) Network the node belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String)
- `address6` (String)
- `connected` (Boolean)
- `device_id` (String) ID of the Device this node belongs to.
- `is_egress_gateway` (Boolean)
- `is_ingress_gateway` (Boolean)
- `is_internet_gateway` (Boolean)
- `is_relay` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
